Shareholder Bank Hapoalim Bm Upped Baidu (BIDU) Holding; Cbre Clarion Securities Holding in Tanger Factory Outlet Centers (SKT) Trimmed by $4.45 Million
June 6, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Cbre Clarion Securities Llc decreased its stake in Tanger Factory Outlet Centers (SKT) by 77.4% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cbre Clarion Securities Llc sold 202,069 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.91% with the market. The institutional investor held 58,999 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.30M, down from 261,068 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cbre Clarion Securities Llc who had been investing in Tanger Factory Outlet Centers for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $2.18 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.37% or $0.3 during the last trading session, reaching $22.14. About 1.24 million shares traded. Tanger Factory Outlet Centers, Inc. (NYSE:SKT) has declined 20.20% since June 6, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 32.77% the S&P500. The institutional investor held 5,315 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.19 million, up from 3,224 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bank Hapoalim Bm who had been investing in Baidu Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.66 billion market cap company.
